definitions.explanation: Something whose outcome cannot be predicted and depends heavily on luck or circumstance, such as a contest, election, or business venture.

examples.japanese: ⟦{勝負|しょうぶ}→勝負：01437_shoubu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{水物|みずもの}だ。
examples.english: A contest is a matter of chance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{水物|みずもの}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{言|い}われる→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Elections are often said to be unpredictable.

examples.japanese: ⟦{商売|しょうばい}→商売：03239_shoubai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{水物|みずもの}で、⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧⟦どう→どう：00543_dou⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: Business is unpredictable; no one knows what next year will bring.

notes:
Almost always used as a predicate (X⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{水物|みずもの}だ) to stress that an outcome is uncertain. Literally "water thing," from the image of something that flows and keeps changing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{勝負|しょうぶ}→勝負：01437_shoubu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{水物|みずもの}: the outcome of a match is unpredictable
- ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{水物|みずもの}: popularity is fickle

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {運次第|うんしだい}: depending on luck — focuses specifically on luck
- ⟦{不確実|ふかくじつ}→不確実：15727_fukakujitsu⟧: uncertain — neutral and more formal
